guidance.statement: Company expects 20% to 24% AUM growth aided by scaling of newly launched businesses.
guidance.quote: we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses that we've launched in the last few years

guidance.statement: Management is confident of adding 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27.
guidance.quote: we continue to be confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27.

guidance.statement: Expects continued improvement in opex to NTI of 25 to 40 basis points.
guidance.quote: we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.

guidance.statement: Management continues to guide for a return on assets of 4.4% to 4.6%.
guidance.quote: We continue to guide for 4.4% to 4.6%.

guidance.statement: Management continues to guide for a return on equity of 19% to 20%.
guidance.quote: we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.

guidance.statement: Gold loan portfolio is foreseen to cross 5% of total AUM by FY27.
guidance.quote: We foresee gold loan portfolio to probably cross 5-odd percent of total AUM by FY'27.

achieved.claim: Crossed milestone of INR 5 lakh crores AUM ending at approximately INR 510,000 crores.
In Q4, AUM grew by 22.4% and PAT grew by 26.7%.
Booked 12.9 million loans and added 3.93 million new customers in Q4.
Gold loan portfolio continued to witness strong momentum, growing by 115%.

pushback.concern: Clarifying the exact credit cost guidance and adjustment for FY27.
Inquiring about ROA guidance details and need for NIM expansion.
Asking about growth drivers, faster segments, and lagging core segments.
Inquiring about AI capex, ROI, payback, and P&L impact.

output.tone_why: Management expressed high optimism, strong business momentum, and robust strategic vision.
